beacon_get_channel_messages.description: List messages for a channel ID. since is an inclusive lower bound on sentAt and there is no upper bound.

items.description: Three-character IATA identifier; normalized to uppercase

scope.description: Transport scope name such as "#se13"; matching is case-sensitive, so the exact casing used by the network matters, unlike IATA inputs which are normalized to uppercase

since.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with a valid calendar date, for example 2026-10-04T15:30:00Z

beacon_get_channel_messages.name: beacon_get_channel_messages

nextCursor.description: Continuation page cursor; pass the value to the next call as-is

beacon_get_packet.description: Get full public packet detail by hex packet hash. Packet firstHeardAt/lastHeardAt are Beacon server receive times; observations[].heardAt is observer-reported time and may differ. firstToLastMs is the span between the earliest and latest observer-reported heardAt values (observer clock span), not the difference between firstHeardAt and lastHeardAt.

hash.description: Exact 8-byte Beacon packet hash as 16 hexadecimal characters

beacon_get_packet.name: beacon_get_packet

firstToLastMs.description: Span between the earliest and latest observer-reported heardAt across the packet's observations, using observer device clocks. It is not the difference between the server-side firstHeardAt and lastHeardAt receive times; absent when the packet has fewer than two observations

items.description: Three-character IATA identifier; normalized to uppercase

pageCursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned as pagination.nextCursor.pageCursor

beacon_list_channels.name: beacon_list_channels

nextCursor.description: Continuation opaque page cursor; pass the value to the next call as-is

beacon_search_messages.description: Search decrypted public channel messages. Messages carry only a channelHash, not a channelId; hash collisions exist (the same hash may map to multiple channel IDs). since is an inclusive lower bound on sentAt and there is no upper bound. channelId and channelHash are mutually exclusive.

items.description: Three-character IATA identifier; normalized to uppercase

scope.description: Transport scope name such as "#se13"; matching is case-sensitive, so the exact casing used by the network matters, unlike IATA inputs which are normalized to uppercase

since.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with a valid calendar date, for example 2026-10-04T15:30:00Z

beacon_search_messages.name: beacon_search_messages

nextCursor.description: Continuation page cursor; pass the value to the next call as-is

beacon_search_packets.description: Search packet summaries; prefer the opaque pageCursor when returned for precise pagination across millisecond ties (region pages may lack it). hashPrefix matches the beginning of an 8-byte packet hash and uses only the numeric cursor in global lastHeardAt order, including with IATA filters. The window is half-open: a packet is included when firstHeardAt is at or after since and it was last heard before until — since is inclusive, until is exclusive (the exact until boundary is inconsistent upstream when iatas filters are used). Beacon MCP Server does not persist or log packet payloads; upstream Beacon may store and return them through beacon_get_packet. region and regionId are mutually exclusive, as are scope and scopes, payloadType and payloadTypes, and routeType and routeTypes; payloadTypeName cannot be combined with payloadType or payloadTypes.

hashPrefix.description: Case-insensitive packet hash prefix (4-16 hexadecimal characters); odd-length prefixes are accepted. With this filter, cursor uses global lastHeardAt even when iatas are set

items.description: Three-character IATA identifier; normalized to uppercase

pageCursor.description: Opaque nextPageCursor returned as pagination.nextCursor.pageCursor; pass unchanged with the same filters and sort

payloadTypeName.description: Canonical payload type name; txt_msg, grp_txt, and anon_req remain supported as legacy aliases

region.description: Exact case-sensitive region slug as returned by beacon_list_regions.slug; the display name (e.g. Sverige) will not match

scope.description: Transport scope name such as "#se13"; matching is case-sensitive, so the exact casing used by the network matters, unlike IATA inputs which are normalized to uppercase

scopes.description: Transport scope names; matching is case-sensitive and matches any of the listed scopes

since.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with a valid calendar date, for example 2026-10-04T15:30:00Z

until.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with a valid calendar date, for example 2026-10-04T15:30:00Z

beacon_search_packets.name: beacon_search_packets

anyOf.description: Continuation page cursor; pass the value to the next call as-is
